import csv,json,collections
coa={r['account'].strip():r['pnl_line'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('finance/chart_of_accounts.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'),delimiter=';')}
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('finance/ledger.csv',encoding='utf-8-sig'),delimiter=';'))
seen=collections.Counter(tuple(r.values()) for r in rows)
print('dups',[k for k,v in seen.items() if v>1])
M=['2026-%02d'%i for i in range(1,7)]
t=collections.defaultdict(float)
for r in rows:
    a=r['account'].strip();d,m,y=r['date'].strip().split('/')
    if a not in coa: print('unknown',r);continue
    k=f'{y}-{m}'
    if k not in M: print('out',r);continue
    t[(coa[a],k)]+=float(r['amount'].strip().replace('.','').replace(',','.'))
g=lambda l,m:t[(l,m)]
out={k:[] for k in 'revenue cogs gross_profit gross_margin_pct sales_marketing rnd ga ebitda'.split()}
eb=[]
for m in M:
    rev=g('revenue',m);c=-g('cogs',m);gp=rev-c;s=-g('sales_marketing',m);r=-g('rnd',m);ga=-g('ga',m);e=gp-s-r-ga
    for k,v in zip(out,[rev,c,gp,gp/rev*100 if rev else 0,s,r,ga,e]):out[k].append(v)
    eb.append(e)
with open('pnl.csv','w',newline='') as f:
    f.write('line,'+','.join(M)+'\n')
    for k,v in out.items():f.write(k+','+','.join('%.2f'%x for x in v)+'\n')
burn=-sum(eb[3:])/3
bal=1847350.40
json.dump({'burn_avg_3m':round(burn,2),'runway_months':round(bal/burn,1)},open('runway.json','w'))
print(open('pnl.csv').read(),open('runway.json').read())
